business_problem: Cube Highways needed faster incident reporting and safer field operations across dozens of toll roads, but patrol teams were using generic consumer apps and the operations center lacked immediate, location-aware visibility into hazards.
solution_summary: Cube Highways uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Cube Highways needed faster incident reporting and safer field operations across dozens of toll roads, but patrol teams were using generic consumer apps and the operations center lacked immediate, location-aware visibility into hazards. Compute Engine hosts RoadAid and the broader suite of internal applications that support field and control-center operations, serving as the compute layer. Cloud Storage secures tolling and operational data across the highway network, serving as the storage layer. BigQuery supports self-service safety reporting and historical analysis for engineers, serving as the storage layer. Google Maps Platform extracts GPS coordinates from RoadAid mobile reports and plots incidents on live heat maps, serving as the serving layer. Security Command Center identifies exposed ports and manages service-account risks to keep the platform audit ready, serving as the governance layer.
